what_human_must_do: Read and accept the project terms in your own name.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Read the docs overview Start with the Base documentation overview , which covers payments, stablecoins, DeFi and tokenized assets on the chain.
2 Step 2 : Get the Base App Base's blog describes the Base App as available in more than 140 countries and says to download it. Details are in the Base App post .
3 Step 3 : Check wallet options Base's trading page , written for builders, shows wallets such as Coinbase Wallet, Rainbow, Phantom and MetaMask among the products it lists under "Trusted by".

4 Step 4 : Browse the ecosystem Use the Explore Ecosystem link on the home page to reach the ecosystem page . The trading page refers to apps and protocols on Base that support tokenized stocks, stablecoins, tokenized commodities and crypto assets.
5 Step 5 : Look at tokenized stocks The stocks page lists Coinbase Tokenized Stocks, each with its own prospectus link. The page also links the legal disclosures.
